# Antigravity Agent Guidelines (AGENTS.md)
> Engineering Specification and Native Gemini Subagent Orchestration Standard for Antigravity 2.0 and AI Coding Agents.

## Overview
- Title: Antigravity Agent Guidelines & Best Practices v1.0
- Author: Alphaxiaoteng
- Repository: https://github.com/Alphaxiaoteng/antigravity-agent-guidelines
- Platform: Google Antigravity 2.0, Antigravity CLI (agy)
- Foundation Models: Gemini 3.7 Flash, Gemini 3.7 Pro, Gemini Flash-Lite

## Native Subagent Model Allocation (invoke_subagent)
- Scout (research): flash / flash_lite
- Builder (self): flash
- Architect (self): pro (workspace: branch)
- Adversary Auditor (research): pro (bias-free read-only audit)

## Key Disciplines
- First Principles: Product-first thinking (JTBD), Evidence over inference, Ponytail minimal changes.
- Anti-Hallucination: Three-state anchoring, Tool output windowing truncation, No placeholder destruction, Two-strike circuit breaker.
- Harness Protocol: Prompt caching optimization, Process self-reclamation, 80-line rule guardrail.
